structured.answer: I didn't decide anything. I'll ask my son or the bank. The page lists many kinds of saving, but it doesn't tell me what is as safe as my deposit and pays more, and it says nothing about what the bank charges.

stuck.why: The page first said a bond is what's inside a product ('במה הכסף מושקע: ... אג"ח'), and this heading promised 'חשבון בבנק, קופה או חשבון השקעות'. A government bond and a 'loan to the state' aren't accounts, and both appear again in the second section, so I didn't know which list to trust.
Full of English letters and stock indexes (MSCI, S&P, נאסד"ק, ת"א-35). I felt it wasn't for me and stopped.
